title: Household and Business Seats, Seat Fees and Tier Movement Bases
content:
## Seats, seat fees and the qualifying spend recorded for each tier

Northbeam Circle Membership records, for every tier, the household seats that may share the membership
benefits, the named business buyers that may transact on it, the fee to add one further seat beyond
those included, the trailing-term merchandise spend that qualifies a profile for the tier without a dues
charge, and whether the tier may be opened on a tax exempt business profile.

| Tier | Household seats | Business seats | Seat addition fee (USD) | Qualifying spend for the tier (USD) | Tax exempt enrolment allowed |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| Circle Free Membership | 0 | 0 | 0.00 | 0.00 | no |
| Circle Plus Annual | 0 | 0 | 0.00 | 2500.00 | no |
| Circle Total Annual | 2 | 0 | 15.00 | 9000.00 | no |
| Circle Total Household Annual | 5 | 0 | 12.00 | 9000.00 | no |
| Circle Business Pro | 0 | 10 | 20.00 | 40000.00 | yes |
| Circle Business Elite | 0 | 60 | 15.00 | 250000.00 | yes |

## Upgrade and downgrade bases recorded per tier

| Tier | Upgrade basis | Downgrade basis |
|---|---|---|
| Circle Free Membership | immediate, full dues of the new tier | not applicable |
| Circle Plus Annual | immediate, difference in dues prorated by whole unused months | at the end of the current term |
| Circle Total Annual | immediate, difference in dues prorated by whole unused months | at the end of the current term |
| Circle Total Household Annual | immediate, difference in dues prorated by whole unused months | at the end of the current term |
| Circle Business Pro | immediate, difference in dues prorated by whole unused months | at the end of the current term |
| Circle Business Elite | immediate, difference in dues prorated by whole unused months | at the end of the current term |

## Notes on the seat entries

Household seats and business seats never appear on the same tier. Circle Total Annual carries 2
household seats and Circle Total Household Annual 5, while Circle Business Pro carries 10 business seats
and Circle Business Elite 60; Circle Free Membership and Circle Plus Annual carry neither kind of seat
and record a seat addition fee of 0.00. The seat fee does not rise with the tier: it stands at 15.00 on
Circle Total Annual, 12.00 on Circle Total Household Annual, 20.00 on Circle Business Pro and 15.00 on
Circle Business Elite.

The qualifying spend figure rises steeply, from 0.00 on Circle Free Membership and 2500.00 on Circle
Plus Annual to 9000.00 on both Circle Total tiers, 40000.00 on Circle Business Pro and 250000.00 on
Circle Business Elite. Only the two business tiers may be opened on a tax exempt business profile. The
upgrade basis recorded on Circle Free Membership is immediate at the full dues of the new tier, while
every other tier records an immediate upgrade with the difference in dues prorated by whole unused
months; the downgrade basis is the end of the current term on every tier except Circle Free Membership,
where it is recorded as not applicable.
